assumption: Development and operations are separate organisations hired in sequence (dev first, ops 3-9 months before go-live)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: operations design and control evidence can be built into the product from day 0
proposed_replacement: One product-operations team: engineers build the operator workbench, run the shadow replay and own control evidence; first ops hire is a controller-designate who co-designs controls
evidence_and_notes: No measurement; depends on engineers accepting operating duties

assumption: Step hiring ratios: ops manager per 6 added staff beyond 4, integration engineer per 8 sponsors, implementation analyst per 8 sponsors, fund accountant per 15,000 accounts, compliance officer above 10,000 accounts
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: supervision span and per-sponsor upkeep depend on configuration variance and queue tooling
proposed_replacement: Workload-driven triggers from metered queue hours and per-sponsor configuration deltas (CNV-ECO-001 meters) instead of headcount ratios
cmp_cost: lower if per-sponsor variance is low
evidence_and_notes: Ratios are [A] from CST hiring triggers; no time study

assumption: Contracted platform build at $60k/month for 12 months ($0.72M), narrow servicing-only scope
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: a platform must be built or bought; scope can be narrowed
proposed_replacement: Owned build by 2-3 engineers with agent assistance, gated by measured throughput (accepted changes per engineer-month, escaped defects) and a narrow scope tied to CNV clauses actually needed by the first sponsor
cmp_control_effectiveness: higher if provenance and tests are enforced
evidence_and_notes: No DAF application exists (ECH-08); AI-development productivity unmeasured (ECH-02)

assumption: Five-person core (CEO, CTO, engineer, controller, ops) at $1,177,750 is the lean organisation
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Role set derived from control obligations (SoD pairs, accountable officers) plus metered workload; roles are accountabilities that one person may hold several of where SoD allows
evidence_and_notes: Report 03: one ops person cannot sustain dual control

assumption: 1,520 productive hours per FTE (2,080 less 12% leave, 40 h training, 15% meetings/admin)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: the 15% meetings/admin share is reducible by asynchronous coordination; leave is not
proposed_replacement: Keep leave and training; replace status meetings with generated status from the work-item ledger; measure admin share
evidence_and_notes: Leave share from BLS ECEC; meeting share is [A]

assumption: Queue utilisation 0.9 of productive hours
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: queueing theory makes higher utilisation unsafe for SLAs
proposed_replacement: Keep; add measured interruption/incident load per role (CNV-SVC-002)
evidence_and_notes: Raising utilisation is not a valid lever

assumption: December needs ~3x average daily capacity, met with agency temporary staff ($34-49/h) and contractors
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: there is no December 31 legal deadline for DAF grant payment; contribution dating and sanctions checks are time-critical
proposed_replacement: Deferral policy (grant SLA up to 10 business days in December, statements and scheduled renewals moved to January), pre-built exception packets, pooled cross-sponsor preparation queue; temps only for non-deciding preparation
cmp_cost: lower (5.7 vs 10 ops FTE-equivalents at 5,000 accounts)
cmp_customer_experience: worse for donors wanting same-day December grants
evidence_and_notes: Report 04 ACT-9; deferral policy [A-ACT-018]; Fidelity discloses 10+ days

assumption: A separate controller reviews and releases; controller hours are not preparation capacity
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: independent review and release is a control requirement (CNV-GOV-003)
proposed_replacement: Keep the accountable controller; automate the completeness evidence the controller signs (continuous reconciliation, IPE run logs)
evidence_and_notes: SoD is not a statute but auditors and sponsors require it; treat as non-removable

assumption: Dual control needs at least two human operations staff once live (three-distinct-person release before auditor acceptance)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: after auditor acceptance a deterministic gate can count as releaser
proposed_replacement: Engine-enforced SoD with deterministic release gate under an independently approved policy; humans review exceptions and samples
evidence_and_notes: Depends on external auditor and board acceptance (CNV-GOV-003 gate)

assumption: Both SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 are required in steady state
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: user auditors and buyers require them; evidence assembly is reducible
proposed_replacement: One evidence system feeding both reports; SOC 1 boundary drawn around servicing processes with platform ITGCs included; evidence generated from operations (SOC2-004)
evidence_and_notes: Exam fees are external; only internal preparation is reducible

assumption: SOC timing: readiness $20k one-off, Type 2 window starts around commercial activation
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: CNV-GOV-001 forbids replacing manual procedures with generated evidence until the auditor confirms reliance
proposed_replacement: Design controls as code from inception and start a Type 1/Type 2 window on the shadow-replay environment before first go-live; agree auditor reliance on generated evidence early
evidence_and_notes: Auditor acceptance unknown

assumption: Conventional sales cycle: first signing month 12, 6-month onboarding, earliest go-live month 18
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: sponsor board, auditor and renewal cycles drive it
proposed_replacement: Design-partner contract with prepaid implementation and price collar; owner-led buyer tests before build (gate G0)
evidence_and_notes: No buyer conversation exists

assumption: Per-sponsor onboarding and migration $105k ($35-325k) with full parallel run
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: reusable feed formats and archive-mode history cut parallel-run work (RC-ACT-005, RC-AN-018)
proposed_replacement: Reusable feed adapters calibrated once per format; archive-mode history import; automated reconciliation harness; sponsor-specific work limited to policy adoption
cmp_reliability: same if parallel-run evidence is kept
evidence_and_notes: Migration effort varies with predecessor platform (A-SPN-017)

assumption: Sponsor-level work of 324 h/yr per sponsor (close, configuration, incidents, audit support, governance reporting)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: board reports, audit packs and close packs can be generated
proposed_replacement: Generated close pack, board report (CNV-GOV-008) and auditor evidence pack per sponsor; human time only for sign-off and incidents
evidence_and_notes: 324 h is [D from A]; no time study

assumption: A fixed engineering team (CTO + engineer) runs the platform independent of change volume
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Engineering capacity sized from the change backlog (regulatory changes, integrations, incidents) with agent-assisted throughput measured monthly; second maintainer for bus factor
evidence_and_notes: Report 03 ECH-3: 2-engineer core implicitly assumes an existing platform

assumption: Office and G&A lines: co-working $6k, travel $3k/FTE, offsites, marketing $20k
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Remote-first with sponsor-facing travel only; marketing through published control and outcome metrics
evidence_and_notes: Small amounts; not a material lever

assumption: Management overhead ~0.5 FTE (Model B) and 15% of hours in meetings/admin
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Work-item ledger (Praxis-style) generates status; decisions recorded once; meetings reserved for decisions and incidents
evidence_and_notes: Praxis itself is under evaluation (echelon-foundry README pilot rule)

assumption: Founder labour is shown at market (economic) while cash pay is below market
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no
proposed_replacement: Keep both views; never present cash cost as economic cost
evidence_and_notes: Burden Externalization if omitted

assumption: 7.5% contingency on cash opex
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no
proposed_replacement: Replace flat contingency with named risk reserves from the failure catalogue (incident, key person, licence)
evidence_and_notes: Flat rates hide which risks are funded

assumption: Insurance programme ~$84k (cyber $5M, tech E&O $5M, crime incl. third-party property)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no; limits depend on contracts
proposed_replacement: Keep; price evidence of controls (SOC reports, no custody per CNV-LEG-001) into renewal
evidence_and_notes: Premiums are underwriter-driven

assumption: Fractional vCISO $48k/yr
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: CNV-GOV-003 needs CISO access to audit committee
proposed_replacement: Named accountable security officer (technical lead) plus independent external review annually
evidence_and_notes: Independence matters for a payments-adjacent servicer

assumption: Compliance consultant $25k/yr for sanctions programme and annual independent review
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: independent review of the sanctions programme is good practice expected by sponsors
proposed_replacement: Keep; supply generated screening evidence (list versions, dispositions, 31 CFR 501.603/604 data) to reduce hours
evidence_and_notes: OFAC obligations sit with the sponsor; servicer supports

assumption: Separate fractional CFO, outsourced bookkeeping and external audit of the company's own statements
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: bookkeeping can be automated; audit independence cannot
proposed_replacement: Automated company books from bank feeds; keep independent audit

assumption: Outside counsel 100 hours/year
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no
proposed_replacement: Keep; use the Unbound requirement/control baseline as issue-spotting input to reduce hours (ECH-17)
evidence_and_notes: Legal assertions in Unbound remain hypotheses pending counsel (CHARTER)

assumption: Recruiting $15k per hire and 15% annual turnover
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Fewer, broader roles reduce hiring events; AI-readable runbooks shorten ramp-up (bus-factor test)

assumption: Exception rate 8% of grants (Unbound) / 4% with reuse (previous) and 30-45 minutes per exception
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: determination reuse and evidence packets prevent repeat exceptions
proposed_replacement: Determination reuse (RC-ACT-004), lazy renewal (RC-ACT-001), pre-assembled evidence packets; measure in shadow replay
evidence_and_notes: Replay: 64-72% of exception rows are repeat recipients (Unbound 14)

assumption: 0.3-0.5 human contacts per account-year at 20 minutes
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: status-chasing contacts are preventable by proactive status (CNV-EXP-003)
proposed_replacement: Status projection and proactive notifications; human route kept for accessibility and complaints
evidence_and_notes: Contact rates unmeasured (GAP-006)

assumption: Reconciliation break rate 1% of transactions at 20 minutes
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: typed rails and idempotent payment chains prevent many breaks
proposed_replacement: Continuous reconciliation with typed items (CNV-FIN-004); break prevention at source
evidence_and_notes: GAP-005 unmeasured

assumption: Complex gift handling 12 h (Unbound) / 5 h (previous), now sold on receipt by an intermediary
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: intermediary carries most work (transfer, fund-borne fee)
proposed_replacement: Agent-model intermediary; servicer handles intake and proceeds reconciliation (1 h); price as activity fee (RC-SE-007)
cmp_cost: lower to servicer; fee transferred to fund
replacement_verdict: better for servicer; transfer, not elimination
evidence_and_notes: Fund-borne fee is a transfer

assumption: Checks are 33% of grants
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: yes for most grants: EFT default with checks on request
proposed_replacement: EFT-by-default (RC-ACT-008) with verified destinations
evidence_and_notes: Fidelity 67% EFT (EV-ACT-015)

assumption: Scheduled 180-day deep charity review for every recipient
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: yes: event-driven invalidation and lazy renewal; release-time checks keep legal safety
proposed_replacement: Lazy, evidence-change-driven renewal (RC-ACT-001)
evidence_and_notes: Report 04: 82 min/account-year if human-scheduled

assumption: Board delegation becomes available ~12 months after go-live; AI-enhanced handling until then
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: delegation is a sponsor board act; time-to-delegation can be shortened
proposed_replacement: Delegation package (resolution, policy-version evidence, board report template) as a sales qualification and onboarding exit criterion (RC-ACT-007, RC-AN-017)
evidence_and_notes: Board willingness unknown

assumption: Reserved authority holders and December surge reviewers are exclusive to one sponsor (SPD-ADV-001)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: conflict and confidentiality risks can be controlled by tenant-scoped sessions and attestations
proposed_replacement: Pooled non-deciding preparation (RC-ACT-002); multi-sponsor appointment for routine decision classes with conflict controls (RC-AN-001)
evidence_and_notes: Owner kept the absolute rule pending administrator evidence

assumption: Unbound platform build capex $5M ($3-15M) amortised over 5 years
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: scope can be staged to the clauses the first sponsor needs
proposed_replacement: Staged build by release scope with stop gates; Echelon reuse only where verified
evidence_and_notes: Unbound labels it an assumption

assumption: Unbound licence = vendor cost at platform scale + 30% markup ($91/fund at 100k funds)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: n/a
proposed_replacement: Price at the platform scale reachable by named sponsors (CNV-ECO-003); for the captive servicer use cost-plus transfer price
evidence_and_notes: Break-even $81-131 at 50-100k funds

assumption: Loaded cost $165k/FTE, 1,600 productive hours, staffing headroom 1.15
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no
proposed_replacement: Use role-specific loaded costs (previous study CST) and 1,520 h
evidence_and_notes: Two studies use different hours (1,520 vs 1,600)

assumption: Infrastructure base $250k/yr plus $3/account
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Metered cloud cost per CNV-ECO-001; previous study prices ~$60k for a single-cluster footprint
evidence_and_notes: Single-VM benchmark 2,100-3,900 tx/s vs ~200 needed (ECH-09)

assumption: Per-sponsor platform cost $25k/yr and onboarding $60k (Unbound)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Configuration by policy packs with standing pre-authorisation for platform-maintained content (RC-AN-012); generated sponsor reporting

assumption: Sponsor entity cost $60k/yr (sponsor's own board, audit, 990, D&O)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: these are the sponsor's legal obligations
proposed_replacement: Keep outside servicer cost; never count as eliminated
evidence_and_notes: Transfer if a servicer claims to absorb it

assumption: Customer acquisition $400 per new account (advisor channel) and 15% new accounts per year
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: For a servicer the buyer is the sponsor, not the donor; model sponsor acquisition cost separately (C09)
evidence_and_notes: No public DAF CAC

assumption: December surge: k=3x arrivals, seasonal premium 1.3x, contractor premium 1.3x
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly (deferral policy)
proposed_replacement: Same as AR row on December: deferral policy and pooled queues
evidence_and_notes: December shares from 2015 press (grade C)

assumption: Staffed administration offer: 4-FTE floor and 15% supervision
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Floor from SoD pairs and roster coverage (CNV-GOV-004) rather than a headcount rule

assumption: Insurance $150k, legal $200k and audit $120k base scaling with log(accounts) (Unbound sponsor model)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no
proposed_replacement: Use quoted servicer-scale lines (previous study $84k insurance, $45k legal, $35k audit) for a servicer; Unbound values describe a sponsor
evidence_and_notes: Different entity types; do not mix

assumption: Payment rails are passed through at cost (servicer does not bear them)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no: rails are real cost; who bears it is a contract term
proposed_replacement: Itemised pass-through at cost; disclose
evidence_and_notes: Transfer, not elimination

assumption: Sales/CAC is a flat $250k/yr
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: no
proposed_replacement: Owner-led sales plus published control/outcome metrics; measure cost per signed sponsor
evidence_and_notes: No sales data

assumption: Fees billed quarterly in arrears; cash ~4 months after go-live
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly
proposed_replacement: Monthly billing in advance on the prior month's average assets; implementation fee prepaid
evidence_and_notes: Buyer acceptance unknown

assumption: 10% annual financing cost on negative cash
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly (equity instead of debt)
proposed_replacement: Stage equity to gates; no debt before revenue
evidence_and_notes: ADV-016

assumption: Statements generated every configured period; quarterly digest default; paper on request
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: no statutory periodic-statement duty was found
proposed_replacement: On-demand statements plus annual statement and correction alerts; cadence per program terms
evidence_and_notes: Program terms may promise cadence

assumption: Quarterly access recertification for privileged/workforce roles; annual for delegated customer roles
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: event-driven revocation and inactivity expiry prevent stale access
proposed_replacement: Event-driven recertification and automatic expiry; keep quarterly evidence for privileged roles (RC-AN-006)
evidence_and_notes: SOC 2 auditors expect periodic review for privileged access

assumption: Two human approvers on every change to control-relevant modules, neither the author
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: automated verification can replace one approver for low-risk diffs
proposed_replacement: Author + one independent human + mandatory automated verification; second human for high-risk diffs (RC-AN-014)
evidence_and_notes: No evidence that automated verification equals a second human reviewer

assumption: Annual manual vendor-assurance review task in release 1 (automated gap tracking deferred)
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: yes
proposed_replacement: Automated SOC report period/bridge-letter tracking in release 1 (RC-AN-007)
evidence_and_notes: Small data model

assumption: Delegations expire within 12 months; renewal refused if a quarterly board report is unacknowledged
can_problem_be_prevented_or_eliminated: partly: lapse reverts sponsors to pre-delegation operation
proposed_replacement: Continuous delegation with annual re-adoption bundled into the board's policy review; unacknowledged report narrows (lower ceilings) rather than lapses (RC-AN-005)
evidence_and_notes: Must preserve exclusive legal control evidence
